loading.title: Loading your adventure…
loading.artAlt: Two young adventurers, a cat and a friendly dinosaur rest on a hill above a fantasy kingdom of castles and floating islands.
tips: Read the explanation after every answer, even the ones you got right.
Practising a little every day beats one long session.
Short breaks help your brain remember what you learned.
Explaining a topic out loud is one of the best ways to learn it.
Pick a difficulty that feels a little challenging, not impossible.
Mistakes are part of learning. Every wrong answer comes with an explanation.
Tap the characters on this screen. They like the attention!
Turn the sound on with the speaker button in the corner.
facts: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
An adult human skeleton has 206 bones.
Water expands when it freezes, which is why ice floats.
The angles of any triangle on a flat surface add up to 180 degrees.
Mount Kinabalu in Sabah, Malaysia, is about 4,095 metres tall.
Sound travels about 343 metres per second through air at 20 °C.
Plants make their own food from sunlight, water and carbon dioxide.
The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.
Birds are living descendants of dinosaurs.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.

elder.name: Elder Rowan
pages: Welcome to Greenhaven, {{name}}! I'm Elder Rowan, and I look after this village.
Friendly monsters live in the meadows around us. Every one of them loves a good question.
Walk up to a monster and press Interact to battle. Each correct answer is an attack, and every wrong answer comes with an explanation.
Mistakes never take away what you've earned. Learn from them, grow stronger, and come and tell me about your adventures!

shopkeeper.name: Nori
pages: Hi there, {{name}}! I'm Nori. Soon my shop will be full of clothes, gear and decorations for heroes.
It isn't open yet, but keep earning gold in battles. You'll have plenty to spend when I open my doors!
